variants.name: g-flat
variants.topology: one Model per placement; the Geometry is connected to every placement
variants.written_by: fbx_channel_documents example over write_fbx_ascii_7400, copied unchanged

variants.name: g-flat-id
variants.topology: the same graph as g-flat, with the invisible identity properties added
variants.written_by: fbx_channel_documents example over write_fbx_ascii_7400, then rewrite_graph.py --variant g-flat-id

variants.name: g-carrier
variants.topology: a machine-named definition carrier Model parented to the scene root claims the Geometry before any placement does
variants.written_by: fbx_channel_documents example over write_fbx_ascii_7400, then rewrite_graph.py --variant g-carrier

variants.name: g-carrier-detached
variants.topology: the same carrier with no parent connection at all
variants.written_by: fbx_channel_documents example over write_fbx_ascii_7400, then rewrite_graph.py --variant g-carrier-detached

variants.name: g-two-level
variants.topology: each placement becomes a Null that keeps the designation and the transform, with a machine-named geometry-bearing child
variants.written_by: fbx_channel_documents example over write_fbx_ascii_7400, then rewrite_graph.py --variant g-two-level
